answer: By the wharf of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The quartz lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the summit is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, reduced by each unverified claim, rewards vest against future work.
